reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A sovereign guaranteed loan of up to EUR 67 million in favour of Elektroprivreda Srbije AD Beograd ("EPS", or the "Company"), a fully state-owned power utility in Serbia. The loan proceeds will be used for the reconstruction of the existing hydro power plant ("HPP") Vlasinske (the "Project"). Also, the Project will benefit from EUR 15.4 million of grant funding from the EU, via the Western Balkans Investment Framework ("WBIF"), approved in December 2022 and supported by the EBRD. The Project aims at extending the useful life of the HPPs (129 MW) and increasing the installed capacity of the site by 8 MW, yielding approximately 313 GWh of increased production, as well as allowing for further development of the renewable energy in the country. Proceeds of the loan will finance procurement of new generation units, accompanying auxiliary electromechanical systems of units and power plant, hydro mechanical equipment and control equipment for HPP consisting of four cascades, with the aim of replacing obsolete equipment.
